description: One OpenAPI specification extension: its publishers, occurrence and document counts, where it appears, and the value shapes observed. CHECK is_api_evangelist BEFORE treating a key as provider-originated — some of these are published by API Evangelist, not by a vendor.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Extension key as find_extensions returns it, e.g. "x-nullable".
